item.title: Trump's golden age faces economic reality
item.description: The Trump administration's promises of a 'golden age' with 6% growth have been tempered by slower-than-expected economic performance.

item.title: Fauci's legal troubles may discourage scientists from public service
item.description: Senate Republicans are set to vote this week on holding Anthony Fauci in contempt, a move that could have broader implications for future government scientists.

item.title: Investors remain optimistic despite global uncertainties
item.description: Despite conflicts, inflation, and tech concerns, investors appear undeterred, according to recent data and analysis.

item.title: Rep. Chuck Edwards withdraws re-election bid after censure recommendation
item.description: Following a House Ethics Committee finding of rule violations related to sexual misconduct, Rep. Edwards announced he will not seek re-election.
